(287)༄༅/ /ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga phrin las yar 'phel bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (287)༄༅// ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga phrin las yar 'phel bzhugs so//

(288)༄༅// na mo gu ru// yan lag bdun ldan dpal ldan he ru ka /'khor tshogs dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs rol zhing*// bde stong gnyis med yang dag gsang ba'i chos// ston mdzad bla med rgyal po rgyal gyur cig / 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa dur khrod sogs dben pa'i gnas su yo byad phun sum tshogs pa tshogs kyi rdzas/ grogs phan sum tshogs pa dam tshig dang ldan pa/ slob dpon phun sum tshogs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du/ dus phun sum tshogs pa tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus su dpon slob rnams rim gyis gral la 'khod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byad byin rlabs nas brtsams dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar bya/ de nas las kyi slob mas tshogs rdzas rnams la slob dpon gyi nang mchod nas gtor la zhu 'bul bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor zhing tshogs rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ sum+bha sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs rdzas rnams kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi sang du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ tshogs rdzas rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i (289)ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa/

dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs rnams kyi/ ḍā ki'i zhing mchog so sa gling*// seng ldeng 'khrigs pa'i nags khrod du// rig 'dzin yongs kyi srid gcig la// mkha' 'gro ni gu zhes su grags// grub thob brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyis// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i zhing*// zhang zhung rdo rje'i gdan mchog nas// nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po la// mkhas grub khyung po zhes su= rgyun mtha'i byang sems= khyed kyi= byin gyis= yul la g.yang chags (290)lta bu'i dogs// 'og min bla ma'i gzim spyil du// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la// rgya sgom legs rgyal zhes= rig 'dzin sprul ba'i= khyed kyi= byin gyis= jo nang dpal gyi gnas mchog gi /rtag brtan mkha' spyod dga' tshal na// lung bstan spyod pa'i rdo rje la// sgrol ba'i mgon po zhes= /gdung 'tshob skyes che= khyed kyi= byin gyis= 'gyur med gnyug ma don gyi dbyings// rang rig bde chen pho brang du// rnal 'byor 'dzin pa rang grol la// rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes= brgyud ldan bla ma'i= khyed kyi= byin gyis= sgyu ma'i rang snang ma 'gags rtsal// dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten na// stong gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la// rgyud sde lnga yi lha zhes grags// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor/ khyed kyi= byin gyis= gdugs pa kun 'dul drag po'i zhing*// bsil ba chal gyi dur khrod du// myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang la// ye shes mgon po zhes su= 'khor du dam can rgya mtshos bskor/ khyed kyi= byin gyis= /phyi nang dbyer med bcu gnyis kyi// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog na// mi shig rtsa dang thig le la/ dpa' bo ḍā ki zhes= 'khor du mkha' 'gro mong pos bskor/ khyed kyi= byin gyis= bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rigs kyi cod pan ldems se ldem// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// rgyan cha mang po khra la la// rol mo mang po di ri ri// glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug

/'khor tshogs 'bum sde sha ra ra// sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne// gtad med rig pa sa la la// brjod med dbyings su tha la la// bde ba chen po phri li li// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// 'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres// gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na ā be (291)sha ya āḥ.āḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon gyi snang ba sgyu ma lta bu mtha' dag bde ba chen por ro gcig tu tshims par blta'o// de nas las kyi slob mas slob dpon la phyag byas/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ// rin thang med chos legs par 'ong*// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// blangs dang blang min las grol ba// de nyid 'bul ba ngo mtshar che/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ oṃ mchod do// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod par bzhes// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing*// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen por mnyes gyur cig /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg bya'i khyad par mchis pa rnams// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// yi dam lha tshogs rnams la= mchog dang = bstan srung rgya tsho'i tshogs= 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i= dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol// dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams= bsam pa 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// ces tshogs phud phul/ de nas tshogs la rol mthar/ lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan ma mig la sogs pa yang*// bsregs pas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ 'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// de nas tshogs lhag bsdus te chab bran/ las kyi rdo rjes gsol btab bya/ slob dpon gyis oṃ su bi shud+dhaḥ dharmā aṃ āḥ zhes bsang sbyangs te/ (292) yaṃ las rlung sogs nas ha ho hrīḥ'i bar byin rlabs gong bzhin bya/ oṃ phi yaṃ phu li mā hā phu phi pheṃ phoṃ swā hā/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas/ ma mo nag mo dud pa'i sol ba mo/ lhag sdud kyi rdo rje pho nya mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa lhag ma'i dam tshig gi gnas su byon pa la/ oṃ badz+ra ni ri ti khaṃ swā hā/ nai wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas shab+da 'i bar bya/ oṃ dhū ma gā tī yai sa pa ri wā re bh+ya i maṃ ba liṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ 'jig rten kun gtso mnga'i mdzad pa'i// 'jigs byed drag po stobs ldan pa// bde gshegs sras sogs bran mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can// dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas// de bzhin khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang*// brgya byin 'dod dga' chung mar bcas// lha chen 'khor bcas tshogs rnams dang*// phyogs skyong brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po= /mkha' 'gro drag mo bsus 'dzin ma// dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs bcas dang*// gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang*// 'gro ba drug po 'khor bcas rnams// lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs byas nas// rang gi lha yi gzugs 'dzin rnams// gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dam tshig can// mchod gtor rgyan dang bcas pa bzhes// dam tshig srungs shig dam tshig can// las la brtson pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig

/las mdzad rdo rje bran bcas pas// zhi rgyas dbang drag las sgrub cing*// theg chen gsang sngags bsrung ba dang*// nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bkra shis 'phel ba dang*// dge legs 'bras bu 'grub par mdzod// ā tsa ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ma mo nag mo dud pa'i sol ba mo// lhag sdud kyi rdo rje pho nya mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis rnal 'byor (293)pa bdag cag dpon slob mchog sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod la phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub shig /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ phyi rol sgo drung na gnas pa'i 'byung po 'chol ba dam tshig gi cho ga la lta bar mi dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// rdo rje theg pa gsang ba mchog gi sgor spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ āḥkhaṇ+ḍa ro he badz+ra shiṣ+ya rak+ṣā mi// bdag cag dam tshig 'di la mngon du zhugs pa rnams// bcad gtubs la sogs lus la 'byung bar mi 'gyur yang*// grib mas phog pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzod pas// skra yi phyogs tsam mthong ba'i mod la 'tsho ba dang*// gzi mdangs lus la 'jug pa bye ba stong phrag gi// 'od kyis phog pas 'jig rten khams kun snang ba dang*// lus dang sems dang tshe ni rdo rje ltar brtan te// re smon thams cad dus 'dir 'grub par mdzad du gsol// sngags dman pa dang cho ga dman// bya ba dman pa gang gyur pa// zab dang mchog gi bdag nyid gtso// lha mo de dag bzod mdzad rigs// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / tshogs mgron oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyis gshegs su gsol ba'am sgrub mchod ras bris sogs rten dang 'grel na brtan bzhugs gang 'thad bya/

mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang*// dpa' bo rnams la bza' dang btung ba khyed kyis drangs/ khyed la rtag tu srung ba mchog gis sbyor ba dang*// yang na yid la 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par shog / sh+lo ka gcig 'di tshogs 'khor gyi yon bdag yod na bya/ gzhan du mi dgos/ /dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni// sgrib pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'gyur bar shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar (294)gshegs pa yi// grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro ba nyid gyur cig /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs bcu gnyis su// dam tshig brda dang bde spyod rol pa yi// bu bzhin dgongs pas bdag sgrib dag gyur te// bde ba mchog gi sa la 'khod par shog /bla ma'i zhabs la rtag tu dad byed cing*// rdo rje dbang mo'i zhabs brten gyur nas kyang*// btsun mo'i shu kra'i tshogs la rtag spyod cing*// gsang ba'i pad+mor rol zhing mchod byed shog /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi'i// zhal mthong de yi ngo bor bdag gyur te// 'gro ba bde ba dam pas phongs rnams kyi// nyer 'tsho rin chen lta bur bdag gyur cig /rnam pa mang po'i bsod nams 'di dag kyang*// bdag gzhan dge ba mchog ni bskyed pa'i gzhi// de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms pa// 'gro la mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /rnam par rtog pa kun las 'das pa yi// bde chen 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i dbyings// ā li kā li rtog med snyoms 'jug mar// bsags pa'i dge rnams yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang*// yun ring 'gro ba'i don grub don la 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang*// gtso bo'i sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par 'gro bas dbang bskur ba// srid gsum rdo rje rol ba lhan cig de yi go 'phang thob par shog

/rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer mtha' dag bsal nas he ru ka gtso mkha' 'gro ma'i// 'khor los yongs bskor rgyal ba bla med ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa dam pa'i grong*// sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyis 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /'dir ni shin tu brtse ba che ldan 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor yang dag myong bar shog / ces dang*/ gzhan yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya'o// de ltar ni gu lugs kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod chog rje kun dga' grol mchog gis gsungs pa'i gzhung kho na (295) gzhir byas// tshogs 'don rgyun bzhin rmog lcogs pa ngag gi dbang pos sbyar te zhus dag par bkra shis bde chen dus 'brug nag bzla ba'i yar tshes la'o// slar yang khyung po dang sgrol mgon gu ṇas bas bcing bsnon 'phri'i zhu dag cung zad bgyis pa'o// ༈ /bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchog /dbus kyi ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran bcas// gsal byed nyi ma zla bas bskor zhing mdzes// phyi rol lcags ri bar ni rol mtshos brgyan// rin chen dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen gter dang brgyad// ma rmos lo tog yan lag brgyad ldan chu// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin bsam mi khyab// dga' dang spro ba skyed pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di// don gnyis bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// brtson pa'i stobs kyis bla ma yi dam dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbul bar bya// sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor pas// mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun spangs nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// 5ba
